title: World of Warcraft and How It Became So Big
summary: World of Warcraft grew from strategy games into a huge online world that millions still share.

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Today we learn about World of Warcraft, a very famous online game. We will see how it works and where it came from. We will also find out why people still play it after 20 years.

items.prompt: Do you play online games with other people? Which ones?
Do you like to play alone or in a team? Why?
What is the oldest game that you still play?

blocks.title: Part 1: One Big Shared World
paragraphs: World of Warcraft, or WoW, is an online game. You play it on the internet. You share one big world with thousands of other players. When you walk into a town, the other people are not computer characters. They are real people, sitting at their computers at home.

This kind of game has a long name: MMORPG. It is short for *massively multiplayer online role-playing game*. *Massively multiplayer* tells you that very many players play together. In a role-playing game, you become one character. You make it stronger, step by step.

First, you choose a side: the Alliance or the Horde. In the story, these two groups have fought for a long time. Humans are in the Alliance, and big green orcs are in the Horde. Next, you choose a class. A class is your job in the team. A warrior fights up close. A mage uses magic from far away. A priest uses magic to make other players well again.

Most of the time, you do quests. A quest is a small job from a character in the game. For example, you find a lost ring or take a letter to another town. Quests give you gold and new things. They also tell you the story of the world.

The best part is playing with other people. A dungeon is a dangerous place, like an old castle, full of monsters. Five players go in together. A raid is like a much bigger dungeon for a big team. At first, a raid had up to 40 players. Everyone has a job. Some stand at the front, some make others well and some attack. If one person makes a mistake, the team can lose. That is why winning a raid feels so great.

blocks.title: Check: Part 1: One Big Shared World

items.prompt: What is the difference between a dungeon and a raid?
items.answer: A dungeon is for a small group of five players. A raid is for a big team, at first up to 40 players.

blocks.title: Part 2: From Strategy Games to an Online World
paragraphs: WoW was made by Blizzard Entertainment, a game company from the US. But Blizzard did not start with WoW. Before it, the company made three Warcraft games. They were very different.

Warcraft: Orcs & Humans came out in 1994. Then came Warcraft II in 1995 and Warcraft III in 2002. These were strategy games. In a strategy game, you do not play one hero. You look down at the map from above. You control many soldiers at the same time. You build towns, collect gold and wood, and send soldiers to fight. The name of the first game tells the story: humans fight orcs.

In these games, Blizzard built a big world with its own history and heroes. Players loved this world, but they only saw it from above. Many of them wanted to go inside it. They wanted to walk around in it as one person.

Many people at Blizzard also played an online game called EverQuest. They loved it, but they thought some parts were slow and difficult. So they had an idea. They wanted an online game like EverQuest, but easier and more fun. And they wanted it in the Warcraft world. Work on WoW started in 1999. So the game took about five years to make.

blocks.title: Check: Part 2: From Strategy Games to an Online World

items.prompt: Why did Blizzard make an online game in the Warcraft world?
items.answer: Players loved the Warcraft world and wanted to go inside it. People at Blizzard also wanted an easier, more fun EverQuest.

blocks.title: Part 3: A Big Launch and Sick Players
paragraphs: The launch, the first day in shops, was on 23 November 2004 in North America. The first month was free. After that, players paid a subscription. A subscription is money you pay every month to keep using something. For WoW, it was $14.99 a month in the US.

Why did so many people pay every month? WoW was easy to start and hard to stop. In older online games, you killed the same monsters for hours to get stronger. In WoW, quests showed you where to go and what to do next. So you always had a goal. After a break, your character also got a rested bonus. It grew stronger faster for some time. This helped busy players keep up with their friends. In October 2010, Blizzard said more than 12 million people were paying for WoW. This was the highest number in its history.

WoW also has a famous true story. In September 2005, Blizzard opened a new raid called Zul'Gurub. At the end was the boss, the strongest bad character in the raid. The boss used magic called Corrupted Blood. It took away health, and players got very sick. It also jumped to other players near them. Blizzard wanted it to work only inside the raid.

But some players had animal pets. During the raid, the pets got sick, and players put them away. Later, in the big cities, players called the pets back. The pets were still sick. Soon everyone near them was sick too. Strong players lived, but weak, low-level players died in seconds. Some players helped sick people, some ran away and some spread it on purpose.

Blizzard needed almost four weeks to stop it. But real scientists were interested. In 2007, two scientists wrote about it in a magazine for doctors. Why? Computers can show how sickness spreads. But they cannot easily show what real people do. In WoW, more than four million real people were playing and making real choices.

blocks.title: Check: Part 3: A Big Launch and Sick Players

items.prompt: Why were scientists interested in Corrupted Blood?
items.answer: Real people made real choices: some helped, some ran away, some spread it.

blocks.title: Part 4: Expansions Keep the Game Alive
paragraphs: WoW is not one finished game. Every two years or so, Blizzard sells an expansion. An expansion is a big new part of the game. It brings new lands, new stories and a higher top level for your character. Old players have something new to do. New players join at the same time.
The first expansion, The Burning Crusade, came out in January 2007. It opened a door to another world. It raised the top level from 60 to 70.

Wrath of the Lich King came out in November 2008. Players went to Northrend, a cold land of ice and snow. There, they fought the Lich King. He was a prince in Warcraft III, but he became very bad. Players remembered him from the strategy game. So finally fighting him felt very special. The top level went up to 80.

Since then, Blizzard has made many more expansions. The War Within came out in August 2024. The newest one, Midnight, came out in March 2026. Midnight is expansion number 11. It brought player housing. For the first time, you can have your own house in the game.

Why can a game live for more than 20 years? Expansions are a big reason. Each expansion is like the next part of a TV show. Players come back to see what happens next. And your character stays with you. A character from 2004 can still play in Midnight today.

blocks.title: Check: Part 4: Expansions Keep the Game Alive

items.prompt: How does an expansion keep a game alive?
items.answer: It adds new lands and stories, so old players come back.

blocks.title: Part 5: WoW Today and Why People Still Play
paragraphs: Some players missed the old WoW from the first years. It was slower and harder, and you needed other people more. So on 26 August 2019, Blizzard opened WoW Classic, a copy of the old game. So many people came back that the servers were full. A server is a big computer that holds one game world. Some players waited for hours just to start playing.

In 2024, WoW turned 20. Blizzard had a birthday party inside the game. The party was from October 2024 to January 2025. An old dungeon, Blackrock Depths, came back as a new raid. Things from earlier birthdays came back too.

Why do people still play? For many, the answer is friends. Players join a guild, a team with its own name and its own chat. Some guilds have played together for years. They talk in the evening, help each other and do raids as a team. For them, WoW is a place to meet friends, not only a game.

But WoW has a problem too: it takes a lot of time. A raid can take hours, and there is always one more quest. WoW once won an award called Most Addictive Game. An addictive game is very hard to stop. So it is smart to pick your raid nights. Keep time for school, sleep and friends outside the game.

blocks.title: Check: Part 5: WoW Today and Why People Still Play

items.prompt: Why did Blizzard open WoW Classic in 2019?
items.answer: Some players missed the old WoW, which was slower and harder.

blocks.title: Final Reflection
blocks.intro: WoW grew from three strategy games into a world that millions share.
